statement: In the classes beyond the box searched by seeded random sampling with independent checkers (400,000 primitive 5-part hives of sizes 31..200; 40,000 primitive 6-part hives of dimension 8..10 and sizes 31..80; 1,799 primitive 8-part hives of dimension 3..12 and sizes 20..40; 12,000 primitive hives with at most D + 2 lattice points at 5, 6 and 7 parts of sizes 31..120, half of them with a third partition of size at most 8; and 5,170 transportation polytopes of the families 3 x 4, 3 x 5, 3 x 6, 4 x 4, 4 x 5, 5 x 5 with small margins, the 3 x N ones images of Littlewood-Richardson polytopes) no stretched Littlewood-Richardson polynomial or Ehrhart polynomial has a negative coefficient; the polynomials with a coefficient below the unimodular-simplex value are exactly polytopes with D + 1 lattice points and h*-vector (1, 0, 1, 0, ...) of normalized volume 2 (minimal ratios 24/25, 44/45, 799/812, 927/938 in dimensions 4 to 7) and one polytope of normalized volume 3 with h*-vector (1, 0, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0) at 8 parts (lam = (4,4,3,3,2,2,1,1), mu = (3,3,2,2,1,1), nu = (3,2,2,1), minimal ratio 393/406), the first few-point hive polytope of volume above 2 in the record.
novelty: study/problem.md and novelty.md of this attack (stage 3, 2026-09-04), the box attack's novelty record (queries of 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-04), the strategy studies study/reduce-and-translate.md and study/prove-the-barrier-first.md (queries U1-U5 and B1-B3, 2026-09-04), and the unit-level queries V1-V2 in novelty.md (2026-09-05): no source reports a sampled search of these classes, a negative coefficient, or a few-point hive polytope of normalized volume above 2.
